svg.title: HybridGuard: three mechanisms of contextual integrity evidence
svg.desc: Three schematic panels explain the value of references, not measured outcomes. A synthetic Native memory of 4 GiB and Web report of 8 GiB do not trigger a global greater-than-8 check, but violate the Native-derived 4 GiB envelope. Normal timezone changes move Native and Web effective offsets together after sign normalization; a Web-only edit changes only the Web offset. The Host geometry specialist compares viewport dimensions after conversion against a container bound; it remains a standalone study outside the integrated detector. All examples assume valid, applicable observations.
